mods.toml.description.chuying:
Chuying Proxy Play: lets a strong external engine (Pikafish / Stockfish / Rapfi) play the maid's chess games (Gomoku / Chinese Chess / Western Chess) for you.
Want a real "old man toying with a child"? Set strength to MAX and let the engines play almost without losing pieces.

Usage: press K to toggle; Settings > Controls > Key Binds to rebind; Settings > Mods > Chuying Proxy Play to tune think time and strength.
